followUp.hi: नमस्ते {{name}}, {{business}} की ओर से। क्या आप अब भी {{interest}} देख रहे हैं? इस वीकेंड के लिए साइट विज़िट स्लॉट रोक सकते हैं — बस YES लिखिए 🏡

knowledgeBase.answer: Brokerage is 1% on purchases and 15 days' rent on rentals. Browsing and site visits are free.
All our sale listings are RERA-registered projects. We share the RERA number before the site visit.
Site visits are free and a team member accompanies you. Slots are on Saturdays and Sundays.
We help with home loan paperwork and a free eligibility check through our partner banks.
Our office is open Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 7 PM.
